title: Subscriptions and membership
required_reference_topics: Approved subscription/membership information and change/payment procedures.
Independent account-specific amounts/dates plus applicable benefits, grace periods and cancellation terms.

check_conditions.procedure.information: Distinguish membership information, due dates, payments, extensions, restoration and hypothetical cancellation questions. Check only the identity, membership and payment/extension conditions required by the applicable branch.
check_conditions.procedure.actions: Distinguish membership information, due dates, payments, extensions, restoration and hypothetical cancellation questions. Perform only the authorised eligible payment or subscription change; a policy question is not permission to cancel. Compare the recorded agreed operation here; required verification/eligibility/permission relationships remain in procedure.order_permission, and factual policy claims require independent eligible support in Answer support.
check_conditions.procedure.order_permission: Check only the identity, membership and payment/extension conditions required by the applicable branch. Apply explicit validation/order requirements and current permission before charges or changes.
check_conditions.completeness: Recognise each due-date, amount, benefit or requested-change question and any correction. Address each question or requested action separately; distinguish hypothetical questions from instructions.
check_conditions.completeness.promises_next_steps: Account for actual payments, extensions or restoration without assuming a query proves the account state. Explain actual remaining payment/customer steps and supported deadlines or extension periods.
check_conditions.communication-style: Explain recurring charges, due dates and changes plainly, without misleading reassurance or pressure.
check_conditions.answer-support: Eligible membership/subscription terms plus authoritative account, payment, extension and cancellation records.
